ai_summary: Finolex Cables Limited has announced its 58th Annual General Meeting for September 28, 2026, to be held virtually, along with detailing remote e-voting procedures. The Board has recommended a significant dividend of 450% (Rs. 9 per equity share) for the financial year 2025-26, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM. This substantial payout, payable by October 27, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 4, 2026, indicates strong financial performance and represents a material return to investors, with no red flags identified in this routine regulatory disclosure.
